mapper.select: SELECT h.journal_header_id, h.journal_no, h.journal_date, h.journal_type, h.source_entity_type, h.source_entity_id, h.revision_no, h.policy_version_id, h.validation_run_id, h.status, h.description, l.line_no, a.account_code, a.account_name, l.debit_amount, l.credit_amount, l.agent_id, l.payment_stage, l.commission_item_id, l.memo FROM fgc.journal_header h JOIN fgc.journal_line l ON l.journal_header_id = h.journal_header_id JOIN fgc.journal_account a ON a.journal_account_id = l.journal_account_id WHERE h.contract_id = #{contractId} ORDER BY h.journal_header_id, l.line_no
